Date:

Regime attacks result in a massacre, killing five civilians from the same family in western rural Aleppo governorate, October 5, 2023

Related News

Man named Qasem al-Za’lan shot dead by unidentified gunmen in W. Daraa, May 21, 2024

Man named Wesam Abu Salem shot dead by unidentified gunmen in E. Daraa, May 21, 2024

SNHR Condemns Syrian Regime for Killing Doctor Majd Kamalmaz Under Torture After Eight Years of Enforced Disappearance

On October 5, 2023, Syrian regime forces fired two consecutive anti-armour thermal rockets at a house in al-Wasata village to the north of Kafr Nouran town in western rural Aleppo governorate. The bombardment resulted in a massacre, killing five civilians from the same family – one woman and four of her children- and wounding another woman. The family had settled in the village after being internally displaced from Einjara town in western rural Aleppo governorate. The area is under the joint control of armed opposition factions and Hay’at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS).

The Syrian Network for Human Rights (SNHR) notes that through this and other similar acts, Syrian regime forces have categorically violated Security Council resolutions 2139 & 2254, which prohibit indiscriminate attacks.

Syrian regime forces have violated the rules of international humanitarian law on distinguishing between civilians and fighters. Such attacks aim solely to spread fear and panic among civilians.
